# Command 34 characters over the budget: bash receives exactly 8186 chars and the epilogue is cut
$ sed -z -n 3p /proc/$$/cmdline | wc -m; sed -z -n 3p /proc/$$/cmdline | tail -c 40
8187
< /dev/null && pwd -P >| /c/Users/user/
/usr/bin/bash: line 97: /c/Users/user/: Is a directory

# Command well over the budget
/usr/bin/bash: -c: line 1: unexpected EOF while looking for matching `''

# Backslash halving inside single quotes
$ printf '%s|' 'a\b' 'a\\b' 'a\\\b' 'a\\\\b' 'q\\"q' 'end\\'; echo
a\b|a\b|a\\b|a\\b|q\\"q|end\|
